name: Greeting
definition: User initiates the conversation or greets the bot.

name: General Information
definition: User requests general definitions, overview, history, or explanation of COVID-19.

name: News & Statistics
definition: User requests current news, updates, case counts, death tolls, or situation reports.

name: Symptoms
definition: User asks about symptoms, signs, or diagnosis of COVID-19.

name: Transmission & Risk
definition: User asks about how the virus spreads, survival on surfaces, high risk areas, or transmission via animals.

name: Prevention & Safety
definition: User asks for advice on protective measures, hygiene, social distancing, or how to avoid infection.

name: Treatment & Cure
definition: User asks about medical treatments, vaccines, medicines, or remedies for COVID-19.

name: Travel
definition: User asks about travel safety, restrictions, cancellations, or transportation advice.

name: Myths & Misinformation
definition: User asks about myths, hoaxes, rumors, or verification of questionable claims regarding COVID-19.

name: Donation
definition: User expresses intent to donate money or asks about donation options and charities.

name: Sharing & Social
definition: User requests to share information, articles, or links via social media or messaging.

name: Gratitude
definition: User expresses thanks or appreciation for the bot's assistance.
